en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a busy harbor scene with numerous sailing ships and steamers moored along both banks of a wide waterway. In the foreground there is a low metal truss bridge crowded with pedestrians and some horse-drawn vehicles. Quayside buildings line the right bank, and people walk and gather on the waterfront. Printed German text is at the bottom, with additional handwritten cursive text across the lower margin.
